title: alchemilla anisiaca f. podophylla
intro: Alchemilla anisiaca f. podophylla, commonly known as Yarrow-leafed Lady's Mantle, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its use in traditional medicine, where it is employed to treat a variety of health issues, including digestive problems and menstrual cramps, thanks to its ability to stimulate digestion and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla anisiaca f. podophylla include its astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating gastrointestinal disorders and menstrual issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
